target_customer: Mid-sized enterprises that lack a security operations team and want outsourced network threat monitoring
problem: Companies could not tune, triage or analyze network intrusion alerts, so unknown threats and lateral movement went unnoticed.
business_model: Hardware appliance plus managed analyst service subscription
product_category: Network intrusion detection with managed analysis

founders.name: Ryan MacArthur
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says he has a cybersecurity background including engineering roles at Symantec and work as a researcher and consultant. The article mentions an unnamed co-founder.

exit.reason: No announcement found; the directory marks it inactive.

technical_complexity.rationale: A learning network appliance with reputation data, machine learning and cloud search plus an analyst workflow is hard for a team of one or two.

defensibility.rationale: No data advantage yet; larger network detection vendors and managed security services could offer similar triage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. The company went inactive with no announced sale.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2015 described companies lacking staff to review security appliance output as the gap the managed model targeted.

brand_strength.rationale: Almost no brand material was found, and the name is shared with a later unrelated AI reliability company named Traversal, which pollutes search results.

outcome_analysis: Traversal Networks was a one or two person YC Summer 2015 company selling a network intrusion appliance with analyst triage, and it reportedly took a 120,000 dollar seed from YC. It is marked inactive, but no article, post mortem or acquisition notice was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. Aggregator claims of a shutdown are unsourced.
notes: The company website could not be fetched because the domain safety check was rate limited. The seed round rests on a single outlet (Xconomy, dated 2015-08-19). No competitor named by TechCrunch or YC and no dated rival source was found, so the list is empty. A later company named Traversal (AI site reliability, 2024 onward) is unrelated; its rounds are excluded. A StartupIntros page naming an Anish Agarwal as CEO was judged to describe that other company.
